name: @gcu/lzma
description: xz / LZMA in plain JavaScript, both directions: liblzma 5.8.1 ported, so what it writes is byte-identical to the xz tool's and CPython's lzma (every preset, the extreme ones, .xz / .lzma / raw, CRC32 / CRC64 / SHA-256, the delta and branch filters), and it reads them as liblzma does — streamed, with maxLength, needsInput and unusedData. No Wasm, no dependencies.
author: Arthur Endlein Correia (port); the XZ Utils authors (liblzma)
